messages.subject: Director-Level Government Relations & Strategic Partnerships Executive | Middle East Mobility
messages.body:
Dear ASELSAN Middle East Careers Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior opportunities where government relations, strategic partnerships, external affairs, stakeholder leadership and regulated-market execution intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, ESG, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates involving government affairs, strategic partnerships, country operations, external affairs and executive stakeholder leadership.

I am internationally mobile and especially interested in opportunities across the Middle East. My experience working across government interfaces, major capital projects and multinational executive environments would transfer well into ASELSAN Middle East's operating context.

I have attached an ASELSAN Middle East-tailored executive CV for review and future matching.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
